It should be treated as the primary source; the externalFindings are cross-reference-only context for the still-missing numeric values.

externalFindings.claim: Irish Riches Megaways (base game, non-jackpot RTP context) is listed at 96.42%-96.43% on third-party aggregators, decomposed by one source as 0.38% jackpot contribution + 0.11% reserve.
externalFindings.crossCheckWithBotemaniaEvidence: The 0.38|0.11 split matches EXACTLY the cluster already found among BOTEMANIA'S OWN peer Jackpot King titles in botemania-jpk-internal-contribution-reconciliation-v1.json (7s-deluxe, eye-of-horus x2, king-kong-cash x2, mega-bars-fortune-wheel, the-goonies-return). Irish Riches itself is NOT in that Botemania cluster (its Botemania page text does not expose an explicit split; only '+1%' unsplit). This is a supporting signal, not proof, that Irish Riches at Botemania could plausibly sit in the same 0.38/0.11 family, but it is a DIFFERENT operator's disclosure and Botemania's own page states '+1%' (not 0.49%) for the combined figure, so the two are not simply interchangeable.

externalFindings.claim: A different Blueprint Jackpot King title (unspecified operator) is described as funded by 'an added 0.86% of each stake, supported by 0.13% reserve'.
externalFindings.crossCheckWithBotemaniaEvidence: The 0.13% reserve figure matches the 'null|0.13' cluster already found for mega-bars-jackpot-king in Botemania's own peer data (active contribution unknown there too). Coincidental overlap on the reserve leg only; not attributed to Irish Riches.

externalFindings.claim: Blueprint's 'Jackpot King Deluxe' engine (launched 2018, press coverage) introduced must-win Royal and Regal pots: Royal must be won before reaching 3,500 (currency units per source, GBP/USD not consistently specified), Regal before reaching 35,000. Multiple independent 2025/2026-dated review sites repeat these exact figures specifically for Irish Riches Megaways: Jackpot King.
externalFindings.crossCheckWithBotemaniaEvidence: Botemania's help-probe query for this exact game uses profile=jackpotkingdeluxe3 (see blueprint-botemania-irish-help-probe-v1.mjs), matching the 'Jackpot King Deluxe' engine described in this press coverage. This is a plausible technical link between Botemania's deployment and the described MBWB mechanic, but the press release describes an illustrative/generic configuration, not a confirmed BOTEMANIA-ES-SPECIFIC cap. Operators can and do configure different MBWB values per market/license. As of the most recent same-day observation (botemania-irish-riches-jpk-current-screen-v1.json, 2026-08-20T06:48:55Z), current Botemania pots were REGAL=15,501.89 EUR and ROYAL=1,689.19 EUR -- both well below these candidate caps, so even if these values did apply to Botemania, neither pot is currently near a forced payout.
